title: Recurring dream in a flea market / farmers market setting
content: I tend to have recurring dream locations and one of them is a farmers market / flea market type of setting which sometimes branches into some type of boarding school cafeteria with extensive rooms of different types of foods and prepared meals. It’s always a huge indoor setting with maze-like continuation and I never seem to get out of it until I wake up. Sometimes there are rooms with clothing or antiques kind of like an antique flea market indoors or an estate sale. Sometimes I am trying to grab as much food as possible before they close. Another recurring dream motif I have is trying to eat a bunch of food before it disappears which happens in this dream location. A lot of the time I’m trying to grab as much food or items as I can in a rush before I’m kicked out of this place but it’s always the same place. I’ve heard in folk myth you’re not supposed to eat food in the dream world so these dreams freak me out a bit besides just being generally stressful.
